title: AniCult just got smoother ✨
items: Much smoother scrolling on phones — heavy blur and hover effects are now skipped on touch devices
Faster page loads: hero images load on demand, and the watch page, search, and local data reads were optimized
The video player is now sandboxed, so embeds can never redirect you away from AniCult
Added reduced-motion support for viewers who prefer fewer animations
Removed unused code and cleaned up the codebase
